answer: Require every identity to post a small burned admission fee plus a bond that unlocks only after several epochs of verified work. A bridge between the identity layer and the payment layer links registrations funded from the same source, so a farmer's tenth clone costs as much as the first. Random spot-checks demand a fresh proof of work within minutes; fail once and the bond burns. A thousand fakes means a thousand burned fees and a meadow of idle locked capital earning nothing, while one honest agent pays pennies once. Crystal-clear costs make the farm uneconomic.
